findings.summary: actionError visibility gap — actionError state lives at component top level but is rendered only inside the 'My Equipment' tab. An optimistic revert that completes while the user is on a different tab sets the error silently; on return to 'My Equipment' the stale, contextless error banner is displayed. Clear actionError on tab switch, or move to a toast/global notification layer.

No build log provided — the build log path (.agents/tasks/api-wiring/build-log.txt) did not exist. A TypeScript spot-check (tsc --noEmit, exit 0) was run as a substitute, but this is not a full Vite build. The log should be present before the review step runs.

Silent badge fallback on unexpected status — apiBookingStatusClasses and apiRequestStatusClasses use Record<union, string> lookups with no fallback. An undeclared status string from the backend at runtime yields undefined styling, making the badge invisible rather than gracefully degraded. Add a ?? '' guard or a default branch.
